a.whyFormulaRejected: The acceptance asks for yawDeg = atan((u_vp-640)/711) = +0.95 deg (7/29) / -1.26 deg (7/30). In the scene convention (onboardCameraMath.ts Rz(roll) Rx(pitch) Ry(-yaw), positive yaw looks right; identical to T3 common.R_cam and checked by onboardCameraMath.test.ts) a vanishing point LEFT of centre needs POSITIVE yaw, and roll 1.84 deg couples about 5 px. Evidence (forward-axis projection at 1280x720, pitch as captured): reviewer yaw -1.259 -> u 661.3 (target 624.4, worse than the old -0.69 at 654.1); reviewer yaw +0.948 for 7/29 -> u 633.5 (target 651.8). Solved yaw +1.6383 / -0.4838 -> u 624.4 / 651.8 exactly; T3 camera.py fsolve gives the same pitch/yaw (13.7179/-0.4838 and 12.8807/+1.6383).
a.acceptanceAsMet: manifest sessions[*].profile pitch/yaw = vanishing-point solution (builder asserts within 0.001 deg); rendered vanishing point within 0.0006 px of (u_vp, v_vp) for all 106 captures (summary.maxVpErrorPx720). Measured image shift vs the pitch-only run: 7/30 about -23 px, 7/29 about -2 px at 960x540.
